products.name: Organic Ribbed Knit Newborn Romper
products.shortDescription: Ultra-soft 100% GOTS certified ribbed cotton with natural coconut buttons for sensitive newborn skin.
products.fullDescription: Crafted from breathable, stretchy organic ribbed cotton, this heirloom-quality romper keeps your baby comfortable through slumber and snuggle sessions. Features smooth flatlock seams, easy-snap diaper access, and genuine coconut shell buttons.
products.materialDetails: 95% Organic Cotton, 5% Elastane for gentle stretch.
products.washingInstructions: Machine wash delicate cold (30°C). Lay flat to dry. Do not bleach.

products.name: Botanical Muslin Swaddle Wrap & Knot Beanie Set
products.shortDescription: Breathable 4-layer pure organic muslin blanket with matching adjustable top-knot beanie.
products.fullDescription: Generously sized at 120cm x 120cm, our premium double-gauze bamboo-cotton swaddle blanket mimics the comforting snugness of the womb. Breathable weave reduces the risk of overheating while softening with every wash.
products.washingInstructions: Gentle hand or machine wash cool. Tumble dry low or air dry in shade.
products.sizeGuide: One Size Swaddle (120x120 cm), Beanie fits 0-6 Months.

products.name: Luxury Newborn Welcome Keepsake Gift Box
products.shortDescription: Complete 5-piece nursery hamper: waffle blanket, star sleepsuit, natural wood rattle, handknit booties, gift box.
products.fullDescription: The ultimate baby shower and hospital homecoming gift. Packaged in a rigid linen-textured presentation box tied with a grosgrain ribbon and wooden 'Welcome Little One' tag. Includes a plush honeycomb waffle throw, modal sleepsuit, artisan wooden rattle, and hand-crocheted bootie socks.
products.materialDetails: Pure combed cotton, chemical-free raw beechwood, water-based natural wax polish.
products.washingInstructions: Textiles: 30°C gentle cycle. Wooden rattle: wipe clean with damp cloth, do not submerge.

products.name: Cozy Cable-Knit Baby Booties & Bonnet Set
products.shortDescription: Charming hand-crafted cotton-wool blend knit booties with stay-on ties and matching ear-cover bonnet.
products.fullDescription: Designed specifically to keep tiny extremities warm without irritation. The booties feature gentle ribbon-ties that prevent slipping off restless kicking feet, paired with an adjustable chin-tie pixie bonnet.
products.materialDetails: 85% Soft Combed Cotton, 15% Fine Merino Wool (non-itch).
products.washingInstructions: Hand wash with mild baby detergent. Air dry flat.

products.name: Cloud-Soft Waffle Knit Sleepsuit with Fold-over Mittens
products.shortDescription: Textured honeycomb waffle cotton sleepsuit with built-in scratch mitts and two-way safety zipper.
products.fullDescription: Sleep comfortably without midnight diaper struggle. Features an enclosed two-way protective zipper with top fabric chin guard and fold-over cuff mittens to protect delicate skin from newborn fingernail scratches.
products.washingInstructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry delicate or line dry.

products.name: 3-Pack Organic Cotton Essential Newborn Bodysuits
products.shortDescription: Triple-pack of expandable envelope-neck bodysuits in complementary neutral earthy hues.
products.fullDescription: The daily foundation of every newborn's wardrobe. Envelope shoulders stretch easily downwards over shoulders for mess-free diaper mishaps. Includes 3 coordinating shades: Oat, Warm Ivory, and Soft Sage.
products.washingInstructions: Machine wash warm 40°C. Suitable for tumble drying.
